commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak score of 26 and benchmark indices extending their losing streak beneath declining key moving averages, Stan Weinstein's Stage Analysis commands strict defense. Under William O'Neil's CANSLIM discipline, broad market direction dictates outcomes, as three out of four equities inevitably succumb during an index downtrend. While select candidates display idiosyncratic relative strength and clear base breakouts, Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rules require capital preservation over aggressiveness. Traders must avoid chasing extended setups, restrict position sizing to pilot allocations, and enforce zero tolerance on stops until a confirmed institutional accumulation signal emerges.

Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price trades above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, pressing its 20-session pivot at 104.09 on 2x average volume. However, overhead supply and unconfirmed relative strength limit upside conviction.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Subdued operating margins near 3%, a modest 3-year average ROE of 3.1%, and steep revenue contraction (-56.3% YoY) fail CANSLIM fundamental viability screens.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A close below the 97.24 stop violates the double-bottom swing low and 21-EMA support, requiring immediate capital defense.

ADFFOODS.technical: SEPA breakout pattern cleared the prior 20-session high on 2.74x average volume. Moving averages remain in constructive Stage 2 sequence with RSI at 56 reflecting unextended accumulation momentum.
ADFFOODS.fundamental: Healthy 17.7% EBITDA margins and a robust 21.8% ROCE with low leverage support operations, but sub-25% EPS growth and decelerating profit momentum cap leadership confirmation.
ADFFOODS.risk: Failure below 309.63 invalidates the 20-session pivot breakout and signals an institutional false breakout.

AEGISLOG.technical: Classic power trend exhibiting three consecutive higher highs and higher lows off 21-EMA/50-DMA support. Up-thrust volume expansion toward the 1530.23 entry demonstrates institutional sponsorship with RSI at 58.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Phenomenal triple-digit EPS acceleration driven by high-margin liquid and gas terminal capacity, expanding operating leverage, and superior multi-year profit compounding align perfectly with CANSLIM leadership criteria.
AEGISLOG.risk: A breakdown below 1383.26 breaches the 21-EMA support zone and negates the active power-trend structure.

ALICON.technical: Decisive 20-day breakout clearing 870.67 accompanied by massive 10.48x volume expansion. Moving averages are stacked in Stage 2 alignment, supported by MACD confirmation above the zero line.
ALICON.fundamental: Sales grew 38.3% YoY on auto component demand, lifting EPS back to positive growth (+22.3%). Modest 11.2% ROCE and moderate leverage require continued operational improvement.
ALICON.risk: A reversal below 790.64 breaks the breakout bar low and breaches the 50-DMA, demanding swift loss mitigation.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Double bottom showing constructive neckline pressure and inside-day volatility contraction near the 953.70 pivot. The stock holds comfortably above rising moving averages with relative strength RSI at 64.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Explosive Q1 turnaround delivering triple-digit revenue (+111.2%) and net profit growth (+151.2%). A virtually debt-free balance sheet, high operating margins (40.9%), and strong ROCE (27.6%) reflect quality.
ARROWGREEN.risk: A breach below 849.35 invalidates the double-bottom base floor, mandating immediate risk cutting.

ATLANTAELE.technical: Bullish engulfing double-bottom reversal on 3.2x average volume, holding above the rising 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA while building pressure toward the 1959.96 trigger.
ATLANTAELE.fundamental: High-capacity power transformer demand supports exceptional ROCE (45.3%) and an almost debt-free balance sheet. However, YoY profit expansion decelerated from 138% to 50%, capping rating.
ATLANTAELE.risk: Trading below 1804.62 violates the engulfing reversal low and indicates false base support.
